calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Herschend
calls.summary: Herschend is exploring the implementation of Growth Book to address the lack of standardized testing tools and improve experimentation across their various properties. The need arises from integrating recent acquisitions with different testing approaches, requiring a clear standard baseline for measuring improvements. Currently, the team relies on manual changes and post-facto analytics, which has proven unreliable. The discussion highlighted challenges in testing processes, particularly around commerce flows that require developer involvement, while content changes are easier to implement. Key metrics, such as conversion rates and order values, are essential for success. They discussed pricing structures of Growth Book and proposed a trial for its enterprise features to evaluate full capabilities. Next steps include a technical deep dive with engineering to discuss integrations.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Feature Flags, Experimentation Platform, BigQuery Integration, Conversion Rate Optimization, SDK Integration
